name: offleaf
description: OffLeaf — an offline, local-first LaTeX IDE (Overleaf-like editor + PDF preview) that runs in the browser off a local backend.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
